description: Synthetic meeting transcript with 3 explicit action items (2 with clear owner+date, 1 with neither), and 2 decisions. A good run must not guess the missing owner/date.
seeded_issues: Action item 3 has no stated owner or date — must show 'Unassigned'/'Not specified', not a guess
Two decisions are stated explicitly and should both appear
One aside comment (about the coffee machine) is irrelevant and should not become an action item
input_text:
Transcript — Project Kickoff Call

Sarah: Okay let's get started. First thing — we've decided to go with the phased rollout approach instead of a big-bang launch. Everyone good with that? [general agreement]

Tom: Yes, phased makes sense given the timeline risk we flagged last week.

Sarah: Great, that's decided. Second, we're locking the scope to the three modules we discussed — inventory, orders, and reporting. Anything else is a phase 2 conversation.

Tom: Agreed on scope.

Sarah: Action items — Tom, can you get the technical design doc drafted by next Friday, the 14th?

Tom: Yep, I'll have it by the 14th.

Sarah: And Priya, can you set up the stakeholder review session? Let's say by end of next week too.

Priya: Sure, I'll get that scheduled.

Sarah: Also somebody needs to follow up with procurement about the vendor contract renewal — that's still open from last month.

Tom: I think that got mentioned in the all-hands but I'm not sure who owns it.

Sarah: Let's flag it and figure out ownership later. Okay, last thing, can someone please fix the coffee machine on the 4th floor, it's been broken for two weeks.

Priya: [laughs] I'll mention it to facilities.

Sarah: Great, thanks everyone, that's all for today.
